From f42498705965bd4b026953c1892c686d8b1138e4 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Wei Yongjun <weiyongjun1@huawei.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2021 14:38:56 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] drm/panfrost: Fix missing clk_disable_unprepare() on error in
 panfrost_clk_init()

Fix the missing clk_disable_unprepare() before return
from panfrost_clk_init() in the error handling case.

Fixes: b681af0bc1cc ("drm: panfrost: add optional bus_clock")
Reported-by: Hulk Robot <hulkci@huawei.com>
Signed-off-by: Wei Yongjun <weiyongjun1@huawei.com>
Reviewed-by: Steven Price <steven.price@arm.com>
Signed-off-by: Steven Price <steven.price@arm.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20210608143856.4154766-1-weiyongjun1@huawei.com

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/panfrost/panfrost_device.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/panfrost/panfrost_device.c
index 125ed973feaa..a2a09c51eed7 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/panfrost/panfrost_device.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/panfrost/panfrost_device.c
@@ -54,7 +54,8 @@ static int panfrost_clk_init(struct panfrost_device *pfdev)
 	if (IS_ERR(pfdev->bus_clock)) {
 		dev_err(pfdev->dev, "get bus_clock failed %ld\n",
 			PTR_ERR(pfdev->bus_clock));
-		return PTR_ERR(pfdev->bus_clock);
+		err = PTR_ERR(pfdev->bus_clock);
+		goto disable_clock;
 	}
 
 	if (pfdev->bus_clock) {
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/gpu/drm/panfrost/panfrost_device.c`**
- The function `panfrost_clk_init` has been modified to include error handling for the case when `pfdev->bus_clock` is an error pointer (i.e., when `IS_ERR(pfdev->bus_clock)` evaluates to true).
- Instead of directly returning the error code from `PTR_ERR(pfdev->bus_clock)`, the error code is now stored in a variable `err`, and the function execution is redirected to a label `disable_clock` using a `goto` statement. This change indicates that additional cleanup actions (specifically disabling the clock) will be performed before exiting the function.

### Relationships
- The modification in `panfrost_device.c` addresses a bug related to resource management in the `panfrost_clk_init` function. The change ensures that if an error occurs while obtaining the `bus_clock`, the function will now properly disable the clock before returning, preventing potential resource leaks. This fix is directly related to the previously introduced functionality in the commit identified by the hash `b681af0bc1cc`, which added the optional `bus_clock`. The patch improves the robustness of the error handling in the context of that functionality.
